title: MGnify recall and pid classify hits with `util::domains`
body:
`util::domains` ports `classify_direct`, the classifier behind the May 2026 MGnify multi-domain analysis. `measure` scores a pair's domain arrangements, `classify` holds a measure against a per-family cutoff and names the paper's seven classes, and `pattern` names the arrangement that scores most. loss-decomp is its one consumer, through `cutoff-pairs.tbl`. MGnify recall and pid are the two intended consumers and neither reads it.

Since 12 October `data/mgy-cutoffs.tbl` carries `hmmer_1..5` and `hmmer_dom_1..5`, so recall has a cutoff of hmmer's own to classify against. recall splits hmmer's hits on the domain letter of its pass string since commit e6744a6 and reads no class. In pid, 9 of the 12 decoys inside `hmmer.prf`'s 1% threshold score through several domains, and 126 of the top 500 do.

## Open
Whether recall still wants the classes beside its domain-letter split, or the split answers the question.
